outputs.with:
**June 3: Book Your Slot at the Repair Cafe**

Dear community,

We're excited to announce the launch of our new Repair Cafe on June 3! This is a fantastic opportunity for our community to come together and help each other fix bicycles.

If you're interested, please book your slot on our website. We'll be accepting bicycle wheels on that day. Don't miss out on this chance to contribute to our community and make a difference in someone's life.

Thank you for joining us on this day of community service!
